tldr: Late-October papers focused on getting reasoning into multimodal models: reasoning-augmented embeddings, latent communication between vision and small language models, and continuous-space reasoning. By early November the research shifted to reliability, covering refusal, perception robustness, hallucination and unlearning.
whats_new: ROSE (Nov 6) proposes risk-aware orthogonal subspace navigation for lifelong knowledge editing in multimodal LLMs, targeting locality erosion and catastrophic forgetting.
why_it_matters: Multimodal models are being pushed toward deployable behavior: knowing when to refuse, resisting perceptual perturbation, avoiding hallucination, and being updated or unlearned after release.

status.detail: A cluster of arXiv papers moving from adding reasoning to multimodal models toward making them reliable and maintainable; all items are preprints.

beats.headline: Reasoning is added to embeddings, small-model perception and unified models
beats.summary: Three papers on using reasoning to improve multimodal representation and perception.

beats.headline: Focus shifts to refusal, robustness and hallucination
beats.summary: Papers examine when models should withhold answers and how reasoning fails under perceptual perturbation or hallucination.

beats.headline: Post-deployment control: unlearning and knowledge editing
beats.summary: Work on removing and updating what multimodal models know.

open_questions: Do any of these methods get released with code or evaluations on production-scale multimodal models?
Can unlearning and knowledge-editing methods preserve reasoning quality in multimodal reasoning models?
take_for_builders: If you serve multimodal models, add evals for insufficient-evidence refusal and perceptual perturbation before adopting any of these techniques; treat them as preprints until independently reproduced.

day_captions.23a2048e82ce2894: Examines self-generated reasoning for multimodal embeddings, arguing against post-hoc rewards.
day_captions.1a8c5544b9b567ca: Studies how instructions, post-training and internal activations shape refusal when an image gives insufficient evidence.
day_captions.abe1652e18273a1a: Proposes latent communication so vision-language models and small language models avoid a lossy text bottleneck.
day_captions.282f057baf2d5931: Brings continuous-space latent reasoning to unified multimodal models.
day_captions.526c07c3667e6cf7: Targets the perception-reasoning gap in RLVR with deceptive contextual augmentation.
day_captions.57b08f9866a26766: Addresses hallucination in multimodal discrete diffusion language models.
day_captions.c43d3ff3aa20c41c: Adds privacy-oriented unlearning of cross-modal associations in multimodal reasoning models.
day_captions.5606760643e4651e: Extends the thread to lifelong knowledge editing for multimodal LLMs.
